summary.title: [Sitemap Integration][Medium] The static deployment cannot preserve the application/xml response header
summary.one_line_description: The prerender route sets application/xml, but the GitHub Pages artifact contains only sitemap.xml and the static host derives text/xml from that extension.

bug_1.file_locations: - /Users/sacino/shoppa-root/src/pages/sitemap.xml.ts - prerendered sitemap route, Lines 5-10 - /Users/sacino/shoppa-root/src/lib/sitemap.ts - createXmlResponse(), Lines 249-255 - /Users/sacino/shoppa-root/.github/workflows/deploy.yml - GitHub Pages artifact upload, Lines 32-37

issue_description.description: The route returns Content-Type: application/xml; charset=utf-8 before Astro prerenders it, but the build output is a plain dist/sitemap.xml file with no response-header metadata. The configured deployment uploads that static file directly to GitHub Pages. Astro preview reproduced the deployment-facing behaviour with Content-Type: text/xml. GitHub Pages documents that it derives MIME types from mime-db and does not support per-file or per-repository overrides: https://docs.github.com/en/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/creating-a-github-pages-site#mime-types-on-github-pages. The current .xml mapping is text/xml, so createXmlResponse() cannot enforce the required application/xml header after prerendering. Reconcile the response-header requirement with GitHub Pages by accepting its XML MIME type, or use a deployment target that supports custom response headers.
issue_description.expected_vs_actual: | Aspect | Expected | Actual | |--------|----------|--------| | **Deployed response** | /sitemap.xml exposes application/xml | Static serving derives text/xml from the .xml extension | | **Header ownership** | createXmlResponse() controls the deployed Content-Type | Prerendering removes response-header metadata before the Pages artifact is uploaded | | **GitHub Pages compatibility** | The repository can enforce the required media type | GitHub Pages does not support a repository-level MIME override |

summary.title: [Build Validation][Low] Duplicate and stale sitemap files can pass the output gate
summary.one_line_description: The validator checks sitemap.xml content but never rejects sitemap-index.xml, sitemap-0.xml, or unexpected files under dist/sitemaps.

bug_2.file_locations: - /Users/sacino/shoppa-root/scripts/validate-build.mjs - required artifact list and sitemap assertions, Lines 11-23 and 45-52

issue_description.description: The desired output has exactly one sitemap owner and no child or stale integration files for this small site. The validator requires dist/sitemap.xml and verifies its content, but it does not enumerate sitemap-like output or assert that the former sitemap-index.xml, sitemap-0.xml, and dist/sitemaps files are absent. A regression that restores the Astro sitemap integration or leaves another sitemap generator active can therefore pass pnpm test:build-output as long as the custom sitemap.xml remains valid. Add a negative output assertion that permits only sitemap.xml for the current non-indexed plan.
issue_description.expected_vs_actual: | Aspect | Expected | Actual | |--------|----------|--------| | **Sitemap ownership** | Validation fails when more than one sitemap system emits output | Validation ignores additional sitemap files | | **Small-site topology** | Only dist/sitemap.xml exists | sitemap-index.xml, sitemap-0.xml, or dist/sitemaps files are not rejected | | **Regression protection** | The output gate enforces removal of the former integration artifacts | The gate verifies only the new primary sitemap |
